checks.name: The active countdown owns its wake route
A competing owner cannot replace or clear the active route
Duplicate binding preserves the original notifier
Explicit modal completion clears the route
Leaving the countdown scope clears its notifier
Exception unwinding cannot retain a closed countdown route
A wake can refresh eligibility without scheduling a tick
A passive wake leaves idle maintenance idle
A real timer pulse still starts and acknowledges scheduler work
Repeated completion notifications remain read-only wakes
A hundred completion wakes cannot create a self-sustaining tick loop
Subsequent actual timer pulses continue scheduling normally
An expired wake requests the one required fresh final tick
The final scheduler acknowledgement is consumable without another timer pulse
Repeated final wakes cannot repeat accepted scheduler work
A stopped worker cannot authorize a countdown from a wake
A passive expired wake still requires an acknowledgement from a failing worker
A failed final acknowledgement rejects execution and preserves the error without a timer
